gen-gf-shantell-sans-fs-chillax: Chillax runs its letters like loose spaghetti, with curves lifted off before the loop closes. Chillax does relaxed, low-key reading, while Shantell Sans, drawn with one fixed nib width and a wide mouth, plays the show-off.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-fs-plein: Expressive Shantell Sans draws every letter with a pen that never shifts pressure or angle, its mouths stretched wide. Plein steps in with a clear channel leading into each round letter, tidying up after the exuberant heading.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-fs-spline-sans: Spline Sans keeps wide gaps between its curve ends and stems, with vertical and horizontal strokes of identical weight. Shantell Sans earns its keep in big, short bursts of heading.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-fs-synonym: A mouth wide as a tin can's cut lid marks Shantell Sans, whose letters all come from one fixed nib width. Synonym's stripe of constant ink gives that playfulness something steady to lean on.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-outfit: Distinctive is Shantell Sans all over, with mouths wide as a tin can's cut lid and one fixed nib width. Shantell Sans grabs attention; Outfit keeps its cable-bent curves open.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-plus-jakarta-sans: Plus Jakarta Sans reads modern and precise, a monoline plain sans with curve endings kept well apart. Pages of it feel crisp and tidy, leaving the play to Shantell Sans.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-sora: Sora is a precise, geometric sans-serif whose curves turn their corners without any pressure swell. And beside the fixed-nib, wide-mouthed Shantell Sans, that exactness becomes the pair's whole appeal.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-space-grotesk: Geometric Space Grotesk lets its counters breathe like a hollow reed cut open, every glyph a ribbon of constant width. Paragraphs of it would move smoothly, with Shantell Sans adding the chatter.
gen-gf-sniglet-fs-chillax: Sniglet stops its terminals short and keeps a level, quiet beat. Chillax, a plain sans of spaghetti-like lines with unfinished loops, would read in a loose, unhurried way beneath it.
gen-gf-sniglet-fs-plein: Flat, level lettering leads, and Plein tidies up below. Sniglet does commanding display work with every letter at the same line weight, while Plein, with a clear channel into each round letter, does the quiet reading.
